questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

_DRG_ZDR_BZD_GBZ_RGB
questions.solution:
Given series: _DRG_ZDR_BZD_GBZ_RGB

Option 1) ZBDRD → __Z__DRG__B__ZDR__G__BZD__R__GBZ__D__RGB → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) BBGRD → __Z__DRG__B__ZDR__G__BZD__R__GBZ__D__RGB → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) ZBGRB → __Z__DRG__B__ZDR__G__BZD__R__GBZ__D__RGB → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) ZBGRD → __**Z**__DRG__**B**__ZDR__**G**__BZD__**R**__GBZ**__D__**RGB → (It follows the pattern of: ZDRGB - ZDRGB - ZDRGB - ZDRGB)

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
30 is related to 41 following certain logic. Following the same logic, 14 is related to 21. To which of the following numbers is

54 related, following the same logic? (NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking

down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc., to 13 can

be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is:

Logic: n² + 5

Now, 

30 is related to 41

→ 30 = 5² + 5

→ 41 = 6² + 5

14 is related to 21

→ 14 = 3² + 5

→ 21 = 4² + 5

Similarly, for 54 and 69

→ 54 = 7² + 5

→ 69 = 8² + 5

Hence, the correct answer is **"69"**.
